extract: Jefferson Scott Shreve is an American politician and businessman who has served as the U.S. representative from Indiana's 6th congressional district since 2025. The district, which was once represented by former Vice President Mike Pence, covers a large swath of eastern and central Indiana, including much of the Indiana side of the Cincinnati area, as well as most of Indianapolis' southern suburbs and the southern fourth of Indianapolis itself.
